mechanism: Erythromycin is a CYP3A4 inhibitor that may increase infliximab levels and infection risk is elevated when combined with TNF-alpha inhibitors due to immunosuppression, plus erythromycin can prolong QT interval which may be relevant in immunocompromised patients.
action: Monitor for signs of infection and consider alternative antibiotics with lower CYP3A4 inhibition; baseline and periodic ECG monitoring may be warranted given QT prolongation risk with macrolides.
